claims.claim: The reviewed OFFLIMITS tights and tracksuits use the documented fits, fabrics and Wicktech treatment described in the article.
Gladiator, Ethos, Gladiator For Her and Pulse X For Her use the upper, insock and sole constructions described in the article.

sources.extracted_facts: The official technology page labels the apparel technology wicktech and its panel reads WICK-TECH. Official product pages describe Wicktech as a moisture-wicking treatment that helps keep sweat away.

Women's Printed Insert Tights are mid-rise, 90% polyester/10% spandex and list Wicktech. Snow and Sonic are full-sleeve zip-neck tracksuits in 90% polyester/10% spandex and list Wicktech. WMN PCT CNS is a full-sleeve polyester hooded tracksuit and lists Wicktech.

Gladiator lists a breathable knitted upper with KPU overlay, memory-foam insock and Phylon/TPR sole, with running, gym, errands and travel positioning. Ethos lists a Flyknit upper, super-soft EVA insock, Phylon/TPR sole and steady-grip/slip-resistance language, with gym and cross-training positioning.
Gladiator For Her lists a Flyknit upper, memory-foam insock and Phylon/TPR sole. Pulse X For Her lists a mesh upper, PU-moulded insock and Phylon/TPR sole.

Organise the article around the customer journey and workout type. Explain the problem and promised solution immediately; recommend products within cardio, strength, studio and gym contexts; follow every technical feature with a customer benefit; and add a proper conclusion that recaps the value before the CTA.
